title: App crashes on startup when config file is missing
body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Delete `~/.gittriage/config.yaml`
2. Run `gittriage --repo owner/repo`
3. Observe unhandled `FileNotFoundError`

Expected: graceful error message with instructions to run `gittriage init`.
author: alice-dev

title: App crashes on launch when configuration is absent
body: Same as issue #1 — getting a stack trace instead of a helpful message when the config file doesn't exist.
author: bob-oss

title: Add support for GitLab repositories
body: Would love to see GitLab support alongside GitHub. Many teams host on GitLab and this tool would be very useful there too.
author: carol-ml

title: How do I authenticate with a GitHub token?
body: I can't find in the docs how to pass my personal access token. I tried setting GITHUB_TOKEN env var but it doesn't seem to be picked up.
author: dave-user

title: Documentation for --dry-run flag is missing
body: The README mentions a `--dry-run` flag but doesn't explain what it does or when to use it.
author: eve-writer

title: Fetching 1000+ issues is extremely slow
body: On a repo with 1200 open issues the tool takes over 3 minutes due to sequential API calls. Pagination should be parallelised or batched.
author: frank-perf

title: API key logged in plaintext in debug output
body: When running with DEBUG=1 the Anthropic API key is printed to stdout in full. This is a serious security issue for CI environments.
author: grace-sec

title: Support for Bitbucket Cloud
author: henry-bb

title: Classification always returns 'bug' regardless of issue content
body: Every issue is being classified as 'bug' even when it's clearly a feature request or question. The prompt may be broken.
author: isla-qa

title: LLM always classifies issues as bugs
body: Duplicate of #9? Getting the same behaviour — classifier is stuck on 'bug' for all inputs.
author: jack-tester

title: Add --output flag to specify report file path
author: kate-ux

title: triage_report.md overwrites existing file without warning
body: If `triage_report.md` already exists, the tool silently overwrites it. There should be a `--overwrite` flag or a prompt.
author: liam-dev

title: How do I increase the deduplication threshold?
body: Is there a way to tune the cosine similarity threshold? 0.88 seems to flag too many false positives in my repo.
author: mia-user

title: Add OpenAI GPT-4o as an alternative LLM backend
body: The README hints at an env var switch for OpenAI but it's not implemented. Would be great to support GPT-4o alongside Claude.
author: noah-ai

title: Memory usage spikes to 4 GB when loading sentence-transformers model
body: On a machine with 8 GB RAM the process uses 4 GB just loading the embedding model. Consider lazy-loading or a smaller model.
author: olivia-sre

title: Rich table renders incorrectly in Windows Terminal
body: On Windows 11 with Windows Terminal v1.19, the Rich table has broken Unicode box-drawing characters. macOS and Linux look fine.
author: peter-win

title: Document environment variables in README
body: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and GITHUB_TOKEN are referenced but not fully explained. Please add a table of all supported env vars with descriptions.
author: quinn-doc

title: Rate limit error not surfaced clearly to user
author: rachel-dev

title: Support filtering issues by label before triage
body: It would be useful to pass `--label bug` to only triage issues already tagged with a specific label.
author: sam-pm

title: Draft reply for 'question' issues lacks context
body: The auto-generated reply for question issues is too generic. It asks for steps-to-reproduce even on pure how-to questions.
author: tina-qa

title: Add --apply flag to post labels and replies via API
body: Per the spec this is a stretch goal. Tracking here so it doesn't get forgotten.
author: umar-contrib

title: Token exposed in error message when repo not found
body: When the repo doesn't exist and a token is provided, the error message includes the token in the URL. Tokens must be redacted from all log output.
author: vera-sec

title: How is priority score calculated?
body: The README says priority is 1-5 but I can't find any explanation of the scoring criteria. Is it fully LLM-driven or are there heuristics?
author: will-user

title: Add JSON output format alongside Markdown
body: For downstream tooling it would be useful to emit the triage results as a JSON file in addition to the Markdown report.
author: xena-eng

title: sentence-transformers model download fails behind corporate proxy
body: On a machine behind a corporate HTTP proxy, the first-run model download from Hugging Face fails. Setting HTTPS_PROXY has no effect.
author: yuki-sre

title: CLI --help output is missing descriptions for several flags
author: zara-doc

title: Deduplication misses near-duplicate issues with different capitalisation
body: Issues titled 'app crash on startup' and 'App Crash On Startup' are not flagged as duplicates. Embeddings should be case-insensitive.
author: alex-ml

title: Performance regression in v0.3: triage now takes 2x longer
body: After upgrading from v0.2 to v0.3, the full triage pipeline for 50 issues went from 45 seconds to 90 seconds. Bisected to the dedup step.
author: ben-perf

title: Support multiple repos in a single run
body: Allow passing multiple `--repo` flags so a maintainer can triage issues across all their repos in one command.
author: cleo-pm

title: Triage report includes closed issues
body: The report sometimes includes issues that were closed during the triage run. The fetch should filter state=open strictly.
author: dan-qa
